migration.instructions: This revision carves new leaves out of the old catch-alls (`geometria`, `bryły`, `inne`, `potęgi i pierwiastki`, `procenty`, `zagadki logiczne`) and merges `kombinatoryka` into `zliczanie / metody zliczania`. When re-tagging existing questions, decide tags from the question CONTENT against this catalog — do NOT mechanically copy the old coarse tags. Every leaf must name a concept REQUIRED TO SOLVE the question, never one merely mentioned or displayed. Keep multi-tagging: a content leaf plus any cross_cutting leaf (e.g. `pole i obwód`, `dowodzenie / dowody`).
rules: Old `geometria`: reclassify to `czworokąty` / `kąty` / `symetrie` / `układ współrzędnych` (or `trójkąty` / `koła / okręgi`) as content dictates; keep `geometria` only when genuinely general. Add cross-cutting `pole i obwód` whenever the task is computing area or perimeter.
Old `bryły`: assign `graniastosłupy` (sześcian, prostopadłościan, graniastosłup) or `ostrosłupy`; keep `bryły` only for round solids (walec/stożek/kula) or mixed/general.
`inne` in the śląskie 'Konkurs ... z Elementami Przyrody' contest that is a nature/science item → `przyroda`.
Fraction-arithmetic items previously in `inne` or untagged → `ułamki`.
Number-line / coordinate items previously in `inne` or `geometria` → `układ współrzędnych`.
General algebraic-expression building or simplifying → `wyrażenia algebraiczne`.
Do not split `trójkąty`; `trójkąty`↔`geometria` co-tagging is fine. Leave already well-tagged questions alone.

Old `potęgi i pierwiastki`: split into the new leaves below. Decide by the TECHNIQUE THE SOLUTION REQUIRES, not by notation visible in the prompt. Keep `potęgi i pierwiastki` only when genuinely general.

CRITICAL — if a power or root appears only as incidental arithmetic on the way to an answer (√3 in an equilateral-triangle area, √256 for a square's side, 10²³ as merely a large number), assign NO leaf from the powers/roots group: leave only the content leaf (`trójkąty`, `pole i obwód`, `ostrosłupy`, `podzielność`…). In a 60-question sample this applied to ~28% of currently tagged questions.

`wyłączanie wspólnego czynnika przed nawias` (now cross_cutting, renamed from `wyłączanie jednomianu przed nawias`): assign whenever the solution requires rewriting a sum as a product, EVEN IF the paper never says 'wyłącz'. Canonical cases: sums of powers with the same base (2¹⁰+2¹⁰+2¹⁰ < 2¹², 2019¹¹+2019¹² , 2023·3²⁰²⁴−2024·3²⁰²³, 9³⁰+27²⁰+81¹⁵ = 3⁶¹), divisibility proofs of such sums, and cancelling fractions like (11²⁰¹⁶−11²⁰¹⁵)/11²⁰¹⁵. Combine with the content leaf (`podzielność`, `dowodzenie / dowody`).

`wyłączanie czynnika przed znak pierwiastka`: both directions — √48 = 4√3 and the reverse 2√3 = √12. Assign when simplifying or combining roots is the point (√80−2√20+3√45), not when a root is merely carried through a geometry answer.

`porównywanie potęg i pierwiastków`: exact comparison techniques — common base or common exponent (2³⁰⁰ vs 3¹⁵⁰), squaring both sides (4√14 vs 7√5). Combine with `szacowanie (zamiast obliczania)` only when the task genuinely estimates.
`ostatnia cyfra / cykliczność potęg`: units digit of a power or a sum of powers, periodicity of remainders. Combine with `reszta z dzielenia`, do not replace it.
`ujemny wykładnik`: only for bases ≠ 10. Powers of 10 with a negative exponent → `notacja wykładnicza`.
`wzrost wykładniczy`: word problems about doubling/halving/geometric growth (bacteria, bouncing ball, compound interest), as opposed to formal power manipulation.
`pierwiastki zagnieżdżone`: a root under a root, e.g. √(2+√3) — typically co-tagged `wzory skróconego mnożenia`.

Rational (fractional) exponents do not occur at this level — there is no leaf for them. Root-of-a-power and power-of-a-root tasks → `działania na pierwiastkach` (plus `działania na potęgach` when power laws are also needed).

GENERAL — the CRITICAL rule above is not specific to powers and roots. A leaf belongs on a question only when its concept is REQUIRED TO SOLVE it, never because the notation, a keyword, or an incidental intermediate value appears. The four leaves below over-fire this way today and must be re-decided from scratch, not copied.

`nierówności`: only when the solution sets up or solves an inequality with an unknown. NOT for merely comparing two given numbers or ordering a list — that is `porównywanie potęg i pierwiastków`, `szacowanie (zamiast obliczania)`, or just the content leaf. The triangle inequality → `trójkąty`, not `nierówności`.

`zagadki logiczne` (currently 425 questions, heavily over-applied): only when the solution is a reasoning/deduction argument with no standard computational route — seating orders, truth-tellers, weighings, invariants, extremal arguments. A word problem that is solved by writing and solving one equation is `równania z jedną zmienną` ALONE, even if it is dressed up as a riddle about ages, sweets or coins. 73 of the current 425 are co-tagged `równania z jedną zmienną`; most of those should drop `zagadki logiczne`.

`podzielność`: only when a divisibility argument drives the solution (cechy podzielności, dowód podzielności, dzielniki). NOT when the question merely says a number is divisible by something as part of the setup, and NOT for arithmetic that happens to divide evenly.

`potęgi i pierwiastki` incidental firing is worst in solid geometry: √2, √3 and √6 in edge/diagonal/volume answers are almost never the point. In the Geometria przestrzenna sample 5 of 32 carried the leaf for this reason alone.
`liczby pierwsze`: primality, prime factorisation, counting divisors. Carve out of `podzielność`; keep `podzielność` too when both are genuinely needed.

Old `procenty` (697 questions) splits three ways. `zmiany procentowe`: successive or compound increases/decreases, 'o ile procent wróci do ceny wyjściowej', percentage change of an area after scaling sides. `stężenie procentowe / mieszaniny`: solutions, mixtures, alloys, blended prices. `procenty` keeps the plain 'percent of a number' cases.

`ułamki okresowe / rozwinięcia dziesiętne` (~91 questions): two shapes, one leaf. (a) 'która cyfra stoi na 102. miejscu po przecinku w rozwinięciu 5/37' — the period length plus position mod period; keep `reszta z dzielenia` co-tagged, it is the mechanism. (b) recognising, ordering or converting periodic decimals — 0,(21) = 7/33, 2,(5) vs 2,5, −1,(1) vs −1,1 — carve these out of `ułamki`. Also covers which fractions have a terminating expansion. Do NOT assign when a periodic decimal only shows up in the ANSWER of an unrelated problem (83,(3)% as the result of a percentage task).
`wartość bezwzględna`: expressions or comparisons with |…|, distance on the number line. Small leaf (~20 questions) — do not force it.

`kalendarz i czas`: days of the week, dates, leap years, clock arithmetic. Usually co-tagged `reszta z dzielenia` when the solution is genuinely modular; assign `kalendarz i czas` in place of `zagadki logiczne`, not in addition to it.

`zamiana jednostek`: unit conversion is the task itself (ary/hektary, dag, cale/stopy, mm³→litry, km²→ha). This is the largest single family now sitting in `inne`. When the conversion is only a final step of a geometry or speed problem, do NOT assign it.

`wielokąty`: sum of interior angles, number of diagonals, regular n-gons. Carve out of `geometria`, `kąty` and `zliczanie / metody zliczania` (a 'ile przekątnych ma 28-kąt' question is `wielokąty`, not counting).
`podobieństwo i skala`: similar figures, map/plan scale, and the k²/k³ effect of scaling on area and volume. Carve out of `proporcjonalność prosta` and `geometria`.
Old `bryły` splits: `bryły obrotowe` for walec/stożek/kula, `bryły` only for genuinely mixed or general solid-geometry items.
`siatki brył`: nets — recognising, completing, or folding one. The question is about the net, not about volume or surface area.

`liczba krawędzi, ścian i wierzchołków`: counting or relating E/F/V of prisms and pyramids ('graniastosłup ma 28 wierzchołków, ile krawędzi ma ostrosłup o tej samej liczbie krawędzi'). These are combinatorial, not metric — assign this INSTEAD OF `graniastosłupy`/`ostrosłupy`, which are for volume, surface area and diagonals.
`kombinatoryka` is MERGED INTO `zliczanie / metody zliczania` — the two were used interchangeably. Retag every `kombinatoryka` question as `zliczanie / metody zliczania`; the leaf no longer exists.
`zbiory / zasada włączeń i wyłączeń`: 'ilu uczniów ma psa i kota / ani psa ani kota' — two or three overlapping sets. Carve out of `zliczanie / metody zliczania`.
`zasada szufladkowa`: 'ile najmniej trzeba wyjąć, aby mieć pewność, że…'. A named technique, distinct from general logic puzzles.

`zadania wieloczęściowe` (cross_cutting): krzyżówki and multi-part blocks (7.1–7.8, a)–e)) whose parts are unrelated. ~139 questions fit; 29 currently carry 6 or more tags, one carries 17, which makes every affected leaf's browse list unusable. Assign this leaf plus AT MOST TWO dominant content leaves — do not enumerate every subtopic.
